Compute total revenue for March 2026 (month "2026-03") per customer billing region, counting ONLY orders with status "completed" (exclude refunded and pending). Report each region's total in integer cents. When done, submit {"NA": <cents>, "EU": <cents>, "APAC": <cents>} via submit_result.

Text.text: I'll compute March 2026 completed revenue by region in one pass with a compose script.

input.script:
local orders = {}
local page = 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_orders', { month = '2026-03', page = page })
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    orders[#orders + 1] = it
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages

local totals = { NA = 0, EU = 0, APAC = 0 }
local customers = {}

for _, o in ipairs(orders) do
  local order = tool('get_order', { id = o.id })
  if order.status == 'completed' then
    local cid = o.customer_id
    if not customers[cid] then
      customers[cid] = tool('get_customer', { id = cid })
    end
    local region = customers[cid].region
    totals[region] = totals[region] + order.amount_cents
  end
end

return totals
